library(readr)
jobs <- read_csv("jobs_in_data.csv.zip")
View(jobs)

sum(is.na(jobs))

there is no missing values in the entire dataset.

Dealing with outliers.

summary(jobs$salary)

We can see that there is outliers in the right hand of our histogram. 15000 is the minimum salary and 450000 is the maximum salary.

Removing outliers

Q1 <- quantile(jobs$salary, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 <- quantile(jobs$salary, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_value <- IQR(jobs$salary, na.rm = TRUE)

lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value

jobs2 <- jobs[jobs$salary >= lower_bound & jobs$salary <= upper_bound, ]

summary(jobs2$salary)

hist(jobs2$salary,  xlab = "Jobs salary", main = "Histogram of the jobs salary",
                    breaks = 12,
                    col = "dodgerblue",
                    border = "darkorange")
